newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil C.Bank may operate in dlr futures mkts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil C.Bank may operate in dlr futures mkts - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank may operate in the dollar futures markets by offering options and futures contracts to its dealers, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said.
The move would be aimed at minimizing the impact of speculative movements in the dollar futures markets on the day-to-day foreign exchange and monetary policies, the newspaper said.
Gazeta said the Central Bank's studies are based on the Mexican dollar options system.

Currently Brazil's Central Bank only intervenes in the commercial and floating foreign exchange markets by selling and buying dollars. When it aims to reduce volatility in the dollar futures markets, the bank usually offers dollar-indexed papers.
